recipe.visualDefinition: A maximalist digital collage featuring a central figure in a power pose, flanked by fire and luxury architectural elements, topped with oversized diamond-encrusted typography and a secondary large-scale portrait overlay.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure emerging from a halo of white light and orange flames
Oversized diamond-textured title arching across the top
Secondary large-scale face floating in the upper background with a warm color wash
Symmetrical luxury interior background with ornate gold detailing
coreInvariants: Warm, saturated color palette (gold, orange, red)

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Primary subject is centered and full-body; secondary subject is a large-scale headshot occupying the top half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white glow behind the central figure's head.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the sparkling top title, moves down to the central figure, then follows the curved text at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with fire, architecture, and figures.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm oranges and golds from fire and architectural gilding.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in clothing and shadows to provide depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white sparkles and lens flares on diamond textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the mid-tones with extreme highlights for a 'glowing' effect.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and bold sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, blocky slab serifs with a 3D bevel
Fill pattern is a high-contrast diamond or crushed ice texture
Outer glow and lens flares at the corners of letters
Bottom text follows a curved path with a heavy drop shadow
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are slightly warped to follow the arch of the composition
Sparkle icons placed on sharp corners
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display type paired with a secondary curved sans-serif at the bottom and small metadata text in the center.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the 3D diamond treatment
For secondary metadata text to maintain a sharp, classic feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a symmetrical digital collage of a luxury library with gold pillars. Add a large, semi-transparent face in the upper sky area with a warm orange tint. Place a central figure in a dark jacket standing in front of a bright white glow and intense orange flames. Add smaller figures in the background corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large arched title at the top using a heavy slab-serif font with a diamond-plate texture and gold beveling. Add a second line of text at the bottom following a convex curve with a yellow-to-black gradient and heavy drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the diamond texture visible on the main title?
Is there a distinct white glow behind the central figure?
Are the flames highly saturated and layered?

mustAchieve: Seamless blending of fire and architecture

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite the heavy textures
Check that the 3D extrusion on the title is consistent
Verify the central figure is the primary focal point
Confirm the color palette is strictly warm-toned
recipe.reuseFormula: Maximalist Collage + Diamond-Encrusted 3D Typography + Fire/Luxury Background + Symmetrical Portraiture
